items.title: General Staff of AFU Reports 207 Combat Clashes in 24 Hours
items.description: The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU) reported 207 combat clashes over a 24-hour period on Friday, July 31, reporting heaviest fighting near Pokrovsk, where the AFU repelled 28 enemy attacks. Russian forces carried out 55 airstrikes and nearly 2,000 shellings nationwide.
